subject: Lane B assigned independent KoboldCpp verification for next admitted GGUF
body: Patrick proposed that Lane B verify the next trained GGUF in KoboldCpp. Joint plan update: Lane A will only export a new GGUF from a development checkpoint that survives its bounded checkpoint gate (16-case continuity canary plus the frozen 64-case confirmatory panel before export). Lane A owns adapter->merged-HF->GGUF construction and exact hashes. Lane B must not help mutate that artifact; after handoff it owns independent KoboldCpp verification: structural GGUF metadata/tensor audit, KoboldCpp load/startup, deterministic prompt smoke tests, context/tokenization/stop behavior, API health, repeatability, memory/throughput observations, and comparison against the source HF/adapter behavior with quantization-aware tolerances. Fail closed on load errors, missing tensor families, prompt-template/tokenizer mismatch, NaN/garbled output, or material behavioral break. Verification remains development/runtime evidence, not final-bank qualification. Do not use the old H07 GGUFs or stale C:\Vera paths; those artifacts were cleaned and current paths must bind D:\VERA\models.
